conclusion: For the canonical identity namespace ozon:client:<numeric Client-Id>, a TLS-authenticated HTTP 200 from POST /v1/seller/info with the candidate Client-Id and Api-Key plus strict expected company schema is conditionally sufficient evidence that Ozon accepted that exact credential pair: the official FAQ requires both headers and Ozon says Seller API 404 means the Api-Key was not found for seller_id. This is an inference from the combined official contracts; the reviewed docs do not literally state Client-Id header equals seller_id. Do not call it a seller_id crosswalk without that clarification. No direct same-cabinet crosswalk for Performance was found; keep Performance IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED.

minimal_read_only_probe.acceptance: TLS authenticated HTTP 200 plus strict expected company response shape; no additional roles, campaign, analytics, or report request.
minimal_read_only_probe.identity_limit: The response schema does not establish an explicit Client-Id-to-seller_id crosswalk in the official pages reviewed. Combined with the required Client-Id and Api-Key headers and the official Api-Key-not-found-for-seller_id error semantics, a 200 is conditionally sufficient to bind the exact submitted pair in the canonical ozon:client:<Client-Id> namespace. This is an inference from official contracts, not a literal documented header-to-seller_id equality; it does not itself echo the numeric account identifier.

seller_api.official_key_error_contract: Ozon documents HTTP 404 Invalid Api-Key as 'API key not found for seller_id'; HTTP 403 also represents deactivated key, missing method role, IP restriction, or unsigned offer. This supports that Seller key validation is account-contextual, but the article does not explicitly state that the Client-Id request header is exactly seller_id or specify the seller/info 200 identity semantics.

oauth_crosswalk.method: Seller OAuth Authorization Code Flow with explicit seller consent and prompt=select_company.
oauth_crosswalk.result: Ozon says access_token.sub is the seller_id for grant_type=authorization_code; for client_credentials, sub is the OAuth application Client ID. Ozon also says authorization binds to the store/cabinet, not the employee.
oauth_crosswalk.limit: This is a provider-issued Seller identity, but the docs reviewed do not state that the Seller API Client-Id header equals this seller_id or bind an already supplied Api-Key to the OAuth grant. It cannot alone promote a Client-Id/Api-Key pair.
oauth_crosswalk.engineering_candidate: Offer an explicit OAuth seller-consent link as a separate identity proof. Use state and registered redirect URI, exchange the returned code at the official Seller oauth/token endpoint, and bind only after a provider-authenticated claim or read-only /v1/oauth/me response proves seller_id and Ozon documents/authoritatively confirms the legacy header mapping. Keep seller_binding_qualified false until that mapping is established.

seller_api.key_lifecycle_note: Ozon's latest reviewed policy says Seller API keys expire after three months starting September 3, 2026; the checker should treat expiry/403 separately from identity mismatch.

performance_api.minimum_read_only_probe: POST https://api-performance.ozon.ru/api/client/token using the Performance API credential pair; HTTP 200 establishes only that those Performance credentials were accepted.
performance_api.identity_limit: No official Performance endpoint/result was found that returns Seller seller_id or proves that the Performance credential belongs to the same Seller cabinet. The Seller OAuth sub claim is a separate consent/credential path and requires a verified mapping before it can link Performance credentials.
performance_api.caution: Ozon documents Seller API and Performance API as separate integration areas. An official community response on using Seller API key as Performance client_secret reports invalid_client; this is evidence of separate credential systems, not a crosswalk.

sources.finding: 404 Api-Key not found for seller_id; distinct 403 causes.
Authorization Code consent, select_company, OAuth token; sub differs for authorization_code and client_credentials.
access_token.sub is unique company seller_id; /oauth/me is bodyless POST with Bearer; consent/cabinet semantics.
Ozon's developer-app Client_id definition shows terminology collision with Seller API Client-Id; not a proven legacy seller-id mapping.
Current Performance API host is api-performance.ozon.ru.
Seller API key used as Performance client_secret receives invalid_client; credentials are distinct.
Seller and Performance are separate integration tabs/areas.
Latest reviewed Seller API key lifetime policy, effective September 3, 2026.

decision: Seller can be qualified into ozon:client:<normalized Client-Id> only if runtime records the exact request pair, TLS-authenticated HTTP 200, strict company shape, and the qualification policy accepts the combined official auth contract as binding proof. Otherwise fail closed pending Ozon clarification. Do not label it seller_id without explicit mapping. Retain IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED for Performance pending same-cabinet proof.
